name: Otobe (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Otobe town emblem in white: a stylised character with a curled lower stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Otobe, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 18 August 1965.

features.role: Otobe town emblem — a stylised character with a curled lower stroke
